title: Protect business document attachment reference registration with live parent scope
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Reuse preceding authoritative parent ownership and live identity/menu/customer authorization for the finite metadata-reference families SalesOrder/PurchaseOrder/ContainerLoadingList/TradeDocument. Caller AuthorizedBy/source acknowledgement must not substitute for ERP authorization. Filter before count/page/candidate lists, exact-reference reads and parent lists; create validates original authoritative parent and fresh scope before persistence, void validates persisted parent before changes. No unknown owner fallback or scope inference from cached names/numbers.

Preserve existing opaque reference identifiers, provenance acknowledgement, duplicate identity rules, immutable parent/metadata snapshots and required explicit void reason. Retain historical rows on parent deletion; unavailable ownership fails closed without reparenting. Bounds/overflow/unknown types and unavailable sources have stable non-disclosing failures. This registry remains metadata only: never fetch remote objects or turn references into downloadable URLs; no new file store, table, permissions, financial/inventory mutation or report entry switch.

Meaningful unit and real isolated SQL tests across two customers and all supported parents cover scoped totals/candidates, forged create, direct foreign Id get/void, revoked/disabled users, duplicate registration and parent changes. Denied calls make zero reference/parent writes; authorized registration and explicit void preserve original evidence. Existing reference/owner authorization regressions, safe Release/full unit and accurate browser blockers.

Services validate parent existence and caller source-authorization acknowledgement, not live ERP module/customer ownership. Knowing a foreign parent/reference Id permits metadata disclosure or registration/void independent of parent workflow permissions.
